cases.scenario: F has its own `x = 7`, the caller has a same-name `x = 50`; F() and an empty partial
cases.expected: Both use 7; the name p0 does not change the rule

cases.scenario: In A01 pass 0 explicitly; separately admissible nil/a null reference/an empty Structure of suitable types
cases.expected: An explicit pass is distinct from absence and suppresses the default; an incompatible actual is not replaced by the default

cases.scenario: required without an initializer, the actual is absent, the caller has a same-name value
cases.expected: Ordinary refusal at selection; autofill does not save required

cases.scenario: required with its own default; separately a reached CODE required after ordinary filling
cases.expected: Both cases follow their normative moments of checking; the default is not executed merely to enumerate candidates

cases.scenario: An optional `uninit:T` that the chosen branch of F does not read
cases.expected: The adapter adds no early refusal or read of the payload

cases.scenario: A computed default writes an event; build the adapter, obtain the signature, check satisfies, call a branch without reading
cases.expected: None of these actions starts an unrequested initializer

cases.scenario: The same default is really read; then an explicit actual; then an independent next call
cases.expected: The number and order of evaluations match the reference ordinary call; the actual suppresses the default; local writes do not spoil future defaults

cases.scenario: One adapter is called from two contexts with different permitted same-name locals
cases.expected: Autofill takes the current permitted source, not the creation environment and not the service pN

cases.scenario: private separately on the source, on the receiving declaration, on both; then explicit passing
cases.expected: Both sides of the filter and the admissibility of explicit passing are kept; service locals do not become sources

cases.scenario: An own input obtained by autofill and changed; separately a transparent binding is chosen; separately a forwarding chain
cases.expected: An own input does not change the caller; an actually chosen transparent link keeps the immediate write without copy-out; the ordinary fallback does not turn into an alias. For an empty identical partial the reference is the direct F, for other wrappers their explicitly described binding point

cases.scenario: F(x; y), the default of y depends on x; partial accepts x = 5, y is omitted
cases.expected: The default sees the accepted prefix and the correct DATA/lexical context

cases.scenario: A default uses node/a nested Structure; several adapters of one F
cases.expected: The original links, the independence of activations and the permitted identity of references are kept

cases.scenario: A call through a named requirement with labels different from F's own names; then a type-based variant
cases.expected: Explicit actuals map by position; implicit filling uses the real candidate; fn-match does not carry over the template default

cases.scenario: A permitted declaration actual and an initializer with a counter
cases.expected: The form/namespace substitution and the moment of execution are kept; there is no early evaluation in the vector capture

cases.scenario: An unknown name, a duplicate, excess actuals, a single Structure, an explicitly named Structure
cases.expected: Selection, W/E and the checks before effects are kept; the internal transport does not open a ready structure again

cases.scenario: `once`: miss, failure, retry, success, hit; on a hit an explicitly written effectful actual and separately an omitted computed default
cases.expected: Explicit actuals are prepared as usual; the first success is cached; F is not started on a hit; an unrequested default is not forced

cases.scenario: `guard` reads only the first input; the second is a computed default that F does not reach
cases.expected: The predicate has its own ordinary effects; the second input is not read by the common wrapper

cases.scenario: `trace` with a passive sink and an omitted computed default
cases.expected: Logging does not force the default; the event distinguishes absence/non-evaluation from a ready value

cases.scenario: `memoize`: coinciding and different accepted values, omission against explicit 0, different autofill contexts, failure of F
cases.expected: The result matches the explicitly described key policy; there is no false hit on the mere absence of actuals; a failure is not cached

cases.scenario: Mixed types, an array, a Structure, a callable, a void result; an empty/full/too long prefix; flip/permute
cases.expected: No int specialization or fixed arity; the full binding remains a deferred nullary callable; a wrong prefix does not call F

cases.scenario: Create an uncurry for stages with counters/errors in the body
cases.expected: No stage is executed at construction

cases.scenario: An intermediate result is declared as an exact callable signature
cases.expected: The chain passes an ordinary admissible call without a mandatory conversion of the result to @

cases.scenario: An intermediate result is a Structure with a model, suitable for the next unary call
cases.expected: The model/parent are kept; the ordinary admission applies

cases.scenario: Different input values return different compatible next callables
cases.expected: The next stage is determined by the actual result; there is no binding to the first branch seen

cases.scenario: N = 0, 1, 2 and an arity larger than all demonstration ones; heterogeneous Ti
cases.expected: The number of calls corresponds to N/the zero case; there is no fixed ceiling

cases.scenario: The final R is a callable; separately a Structure, a primitive and void
cases.expected: The real R/void is returned; the final callable is not executed by an extra step

cases.scenario: An intermediate result is unusable for the next call; an incompatible input or final R
cases.expected: An ordinary refusal at the point reached; later bodies are not executed, types are not erased

cases.scenario: A declared failure at each position, different payloads; separately an implicit failure
cases.expected: The name/payload and the ordinary handling are kept; a system failure is not hidden as a user Result

cases.scenario: Ready actuals for comparison with a manual chain; separately actual expressions with effects
cases.expected: The stages coincide for ready values; flat expressions are evaluated in the ordinary order of a flat call

cases.scenario: A chain from `curry` and an independent user chain
cases.expected: Both use one ordinary mechanism; no private mark "created by our library" is needed

cases.scenario: The obtained stage outlives the creation of the wrapper; a native/walker transition; a permitted graph change
cases.expected: There is no reference to a finished C-stack local; the ordinary lifetime and the boundaries of validity of compiled entries apply
